pl-l4d21c3-d1e112.summary: States that in that purgatorial fire some are purged more slowly, others more quickly, according as they loved these perishing things more or less.
claims: The length of purgation depends on attachment to perishable things.

pl-l4d21c3-d1e115.summary: Quotes Augustine: after this life it is not incredible that some believers are saved through a purgatorial fire, more slowly or more quickly as they loved perishing goods more or less.
claims: Purgation varies with love of perishing goods.

pl-l4d21c3.summary: Teaches that in the purgatorial fire some are purged more slowly, others more quickly, according to how much they loved perishable things; Augustine finds it not incredible that some believers are saved through a purgatorial fire more slowly or quickly as they loved perishing goods more or less.
claims: Purgation is longer or shorter according to attachment to perishable goods.
